title.en: Electric 30 or low-pressure 40 for fine-stone buildings, read as separate catalogue cells
title.zh: 细石建筑选电动30还是低压40，各格分开读

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. If the mix is fine stone and the pipe fits 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, Electric 30 is the printed row at 30 kW. Taken from the printed row: If the fine-stone pipe needs the longer 80 m / 240 m window, open Electric Low Pressure 40 at 37 kW. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints both as building pumps at 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Only Electric 30 also prints aggregate 13 at 20 m / 60 m.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：料是细石且管路落在水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m 内，电动30就是 30 kW 的那一行。细石管路需要更长的 80 m / 240 m 窗口，就打开 37 kW 的电动低压40。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都写成 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa 的建筑泵。只有电动30另外印了 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。

body.zh: “结构部位方案分项”是《Shear wall》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：两台都是 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa。电动30细石是 60 m / 180 m，并另有 13 骨料行。低压40细石是 80 m / 240 m，没有 13 骨料行。按邢台表上的原文理解：只有你能确认料名是细石时，才写“细石”。按邢台表上的原文理解：/solutions/construction，因为两台产品都印了建筑与商业浇筑。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shear_wall

heading.en: Arrangement in buildings with different functions

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Arrangement in buildings with different functions” from “Shear wall”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: Electric 30 fine stone is 60 m / 180 m and also has aggregate 13. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery prints both as building pumps at 12–15 m³/h and 20 MPa. Taken from the printed row: The fine-stone distances differ. Taken from the printed row: Electric Low Pressure 40 does not print that second distance and does not print a maximum-aggregate cell in the specification list. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Taken from the printed row: The distances do not match just because the weight does. Taken from the printed row: /solutions/construction, because both products print building and commercial placement.
body.zh: 本节保留《Shear wall》的标题“建筑作用”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。料是细石且管路落在水平 60 m / 垂直 180 m 内，电动30就是 30 kW 的那一行。细石管路需要更长的 80 m / 240 m 窗口，就打开 37 kW 的电动低压40。河北品锦机械（邢台）把两台都写成 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa 的建筑泵。只有电动30另外印了 13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。目录里已经写着：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Construction methods” in “Shear wall”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Keep this cell as published. Low-pressure 40 fine stone is 80 m / 240 m and has no aggregate-13 row. Keep this cell as published. Only Electric 30 also prints aggregate 13 at 20 m / 60 m. Keep this cell as published. Low-pressure 40 also prints a Kawasaki 112 hydraulic pump cell that Electric 30’s table does not list in the same way. Keep this cell as published. A 13-aggregate building line should not be assigned to the low-pressure 40 from silence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Keep this cell as published. No.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Shear wall》的“建造工法”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。这一格照已印出的读：两台都列了 12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg。电机不同（30 kW 和 37 kW）。细石距离不同。低压40还印了川崎 112 液压泵格，电动30的表没有按同样方式列出。先对你需要的距离行，再对现场能供的电机。这一格照已印出的读：一样。两台都印 1200 kg。重量相同并不表示距离相同。

body.en: “Shear wall” breaks its subject at “Nonplanar shear walls”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. If the mix is fine stone and the pipe fits 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, Electric 30 is the printed row at 30 kW. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Both list 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, size 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Match the distance row you need, then the motor the site can feed. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Write “fine stone” only if that is the mix name you can stand behind. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Standard Electric 40 is 45 kW and 21 m³/h. Headings already printed: Aggregate 13 has only one of these pages
body.zh: 《Shear wall》在“剪切墙”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动30最大骨料是 ≤ 3 cm，并有较短的 13 骨料距离。电动低压40没有印第二段距离，规格表里也没有最大骨料格。不能因为空白就把 13 骨料建筑管路分给低压40。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不在。标准电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h，属于中型建筑行。已印出的标题：13 骨料只在其中一页

question.en: “Structural design considerations” does not change the check: Are the weights the same?
question.zh: “结构部位方案分项”不改这一问：重量一样吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Yes. Both print 1200 kg. The distances do not match just because the weight does.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：一样。两台都印 1200 kg。重量相同并不表示距离相同。

question.en: Is the standard Electric 40 in this pair, once the outline says “Arrangement in buildings with different functions”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“建筑作用”时，标准电动40在这一对里吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. Standard Electric 40 is 45 kW and 21 m³/h. It is the medium-building row.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不在。标准电动40是 45 kW、21 m³/h，属于中型建筑行。

question.en: Under “Construction methods”, which solution page applies?
question.zh: 在“建造工法”这一节里，对应哪一页应用？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. /solutions/construction, because both products print building and commercial placement.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：/solutions/construction，因为两台产品都印了建筑与商业浇筑。
